Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Quick clarification:

Can I move more blood off a vampire than the capacity of the receiving vampire?
e.g. Serena the White has 5 blood when I lock Heidelberg Castle to move blood off another vampire (with 7 blood) to her. Can I move 6 blood, leaving the other vampire with just 1, or can I only move 3 blood as that would bring Serena to full capacity?

> Name: Serenna the White
> [HttB:U]
> Cardtype: Vampire
> Clan: Salubri
> Group: 6
> Capacity: 8
> Discipline: ani dem AUS FOR OBE
> Independent: Once each turn, if Serenna is ready, she may burn 1 blood to reduce a bleed against you by 2. Scarce.
> Artist: Ed Tadem
>
> Name: Heidelberg Castle, Germany
> [DS:U2, FN:PR, KMW:PAl, LoB:PI]
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 2 pool
> Master: unique location.
> Lock to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control. (You choose the amount of blood you move and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.
> Artist: L. A. Williams
>

It was the stolen vampire that had Fortitude. And whether it had it at inferior or superior doesn't matter: you can play Force of Will and Daring at inferior anyway (even if that vampire has superior Fortitude).
